meta.source: Luft Portfolio design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/MPth3z4whA4Ui8FEaZ8aN2), moodboard and Radio Luft posts

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every page body sits on paper.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Newspaper panels, cards, the App ideas band.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Soft hairlines: header underline on mobile, browser chrome. Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and line art on paper, paper-deep, yellow and violet. Also the 2px border on cards, buttons and images.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: standfirsts, descriptions, captions on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only, 12px and up, on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and rules: 2px around cards and buttons, 1px or 3px for newspaper rules.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: THE accent. Primary-accent buttons, poster cards, stickers, highlighted words, the current track. Text on it is always on-yellow.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and line art on yellow, in both themes.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Radio Luft and big colour bands. Body text on it is on-violet; white only for display type 24px and up.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Body text on violet (5.1:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links, pull quotes, the Mozaik text, the Radio hero ground (light theme).

tokens.name: quote-ground
tokens.usage: Ground for Radio Luft quote panels; text on it is blue.

tokens.name: photo
tokens.usage: Ground behind B&W photos and photo placeholders.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Placeholder labels on photo ground.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Footer and Next-project band ground.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Display type on violet or blue only (24px and up).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the Say hi sheet.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Footer sign-off, page titles (Art, Work). Turn on SOFT 100 and WONK 1.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Paper Dogs: a café that draws its regulars
styles.usage: Case-study headline. Regular weight, no SOFT/WONK.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Newspaper panel titles, subheads in case studies.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: One set of characters, drawn once.
styles.usage: Pull quotes, in blue between 1px rules.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Work, art and a little radio.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I sketched the dogs that came in every morning.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and section labels. Always uppercase, always tracked.

styles.name: radio-quote
styles.sample: Uzmeš delove od nota i reči…

styles.name: track
styles.usage: Playlist rows: song in 700, artist in 400.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The LUFT wordmark, uppercase. 44px desktop header, 34px mobile, 24–28px footer. Nothing else uses this face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, nav row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gaps for images; mobile gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Poster card padding, gap between hero halves.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space before a new major section.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, poster cards, images. Luft is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Contact rows in the Say hi sheet, small UI inside app mockups.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the mobile Say hi sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter pills, icon buttons, avatar.

border.note: Borders are ink. Shadows are not used, except the one offset block shadow.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Newspaper rules, fact-row dividers, playlist rows.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, images on colour bands, section top rules.

tokens.name: border-masthead
tokens.usage: The top rule of a newspaper masthead.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Hard yellow offset under the Say hi dialog and phone mockups. Use once per screen.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of every section's inner wrapper.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side gutter under 600px.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.
